title: Leave Request and Approval
scope: Applies to Business Analysts during their first 30 days.
summary: Defines the standard leave request process.
details: Submit planned leave through the approved process.
Manager approval is required unless local rules differ.
Prepare handover notes for critical activities.
Do not share medical details in general channels.
escalation: Contact HR Operations for overdue leave approvals.
exceptions: Any exception requires documented approval from the policy owner.
